description: This file implements a process-local, re-entrant file locking mechanism using lock files, with functions for acquiring, releasing, and managing locks, including cleanup and stale lock detection.

methods.name: releaseAllLocksSync
methods.description: Synchronously releases all held locks and cleans up lock files.

methods.name: drainAllLocks
methods.description: Asynchronously releases all locks and removes lock files.

methods.name: rmLockPathSync
methods.description: Synchronously removes a lock file, best-effort.

methods.name: ensureExitCleanupRegistered
methods.description: Registers process exit handler to release all locks on exit.

methods.name: computeDelayMs
methods.description: Calculates delay with jitter for retry attempts based on retries options.

methods.name: readLockPayload
methods.description: Reads and parses lock file payload, returns null if invalid or error.

methods.name: resolveNormalizedFilePath
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes file path, ensuring directory exists.

methods.name: isStaleLock
methods.description: Determines if a lock file is stale based on PID and timestamp.

methods.name: releaseHeldLock
methods.description: Releases a specific held lock, decreasing reference count and cleaning up.

methods.name: resetFileLockStateForTest
methods.description: Resets lock state for testing purposes.

methods.name: drainFileLockStateForTest
methods.description: Drains all lock state for testing purposes.

methods.name: acquireFileLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a re-entrant file lock with retries and stale lock handling.

methods.name: withFileLock
methods.description: Executes an async function while holding a file lock, ensuring release afterward.
